_comment: Contributed capital for the Robinhood agentic account (Arm B). Subtract from equity before any performance comparison. Source: Devon's Robinhood transfer history, read 2026-08-17. This SUPERSEDES the earlier log-derived estimates, which were wrong on both dates and count.
detection: Authoritative broker transfer history. Ongoing deposits are captured live by rh_daemon.py from the broker pending_deposits rising edge.

baseline.note: Account value when the bot began trading. Deposits before this date (weekly $10 back to at least 2026-06-23, less a $0.24 transfer out on 07-22) are already inside this figure and must NOT be added again.

events.note: weekly recurring from Bank of Little Rock

how_to_use: performance = current_total_value - total_contributed_capital. Do NOT use starting_equity alone as the baseline, and do NOT add pre-2026-07-23 deposits.
